services.desc: Reservations for your Lake Tahoe Fishing Charter can be secured with a credit card upon booking. Payment in full is not due until after completion of the charter. By booking with Reel-Lentless fishing charters you are agreeing to the cancellation policy. Cancellation Policy: Charters cancelled inside of 7 days will be charged in full to the credit card on file.
